newsitem.title: JAPAN: Ube Industries says to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Ube Industries says to buy back shares.

text.p: Ube Industries Ltd said on Friday that it would buy back up to 2.24 million of its own shares, or up to one billion yen worth.
Ube said in a statement that the shares to be repurchased would be transferred to board members and senior executives under a stock option scheme that the company is planning to introduce.
"We aim to give incentives to our senior executives and encourage more aggressive management by introducing a stock option scheme," Ube said.
Japan's parliament on Friday approved changes to the commercial code to allow firms to buy back up to 10 percent of their own shares for use in stock-option schemes for employees and executives.
The change will take effect from June 1.
Stock options give holders the right to buy shares at a set price within a certain period.
